name: v3_video_3_gold_spread
prompt:
A hand grips a metal palette knife and spreads the gold metallic paint across the entire palette surface.
The palette knife drags the shimmering gold over the remaining brown areas, covering everything in gold.
Gold paint spreads smoothly, glitter sparkles catching the light as the knife moves.
Continuous hand movement, the hand never stops spreading.
Top-down flat lay, static camera, close-up.
